# Leonit Xhini

> Independent developer and digital product builder. Websites, mobile apps, AI and automation, custom software and SaaS for small businesses and companies digitising their systems. Works in English, German and Albanian.

## Selected work

- [ZgjedhPlus](https://lxclouds.com/work/zgjedhplus): Price comparison platform for Kosovo and Albania. Independent product.
- [FrameNotion](https://lxclouds.com/work/framenotion): Turns product links into short ad videos. Independent product.
- [RRON Rent a Car](https://lxclouds.com/work/rron-rent-a-car): Website for a vehicle rental company. Client project.
- [SubToAPI](https://lxclouds.com/work/subtoapi): Developer platform that connects supported Claude access to applications through an API. Independent product.
